Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.en: Breathe in... And out... I am calm... I have nothing to worry about... All will be well...
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.cz: Nadechni se... A vydechni... Jsem klidný... Nemám se čeho bát... Všechno bude v pořádku...

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.en: The small chef you have here... Are you sure he can tell a friend from a fricassee?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.cz: Ten malý kuchař, co tu máte... Jste si jistý, že dokáže rozlišit přítele od frikasé?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.en: If you know any crustaceans who play instruments, send them to me.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.cz: Pokud znáte nějaké korýše, kteří hrají na nástroje, pošlete je za mnou.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.en: You musicians better not be late for rehearsal!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.cz: Vy hudebníci byste se neměli zpožďovat na zkoušku!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.en: If you want to explore under the sea, you'll find no better guide than me.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.cz: Pokud chceš prozkoumat podmořský svět, nenajdeš lepšího průvodce než mě.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.en: Horatio Felonious Ignacious Crustaceous Sebastian, at your service!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.cz: Horatio Felonious Ignacious Crustaceous Sebastian, k vašim službám!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.en: Now where is that Ariel off to now?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.cz: Kam se teď ta Ariel vydala?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.en: There's nothing better than a seaweed scrub to start the day!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.cz: Není nic lepšího než mořská řasa na začátek dne!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.en: I'm gonna have myself a nice quiet evening working on my music.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.cz: Dám si hezký klidný večer a budu pracovat na své hudbě.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.en: I think the rain is lovely, but I'll be having none of that thunder and lightning!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.cz: Myslím, že déšť je nádherný, ale žádné hromy a blesky nechci!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.en: Ooh, that sun is hot! Under the sea we don't have to deal with such things.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Bark.cz: Ooh, to slunce je horké! Pod mořem se s takovými věcmi nemusíme potýkat.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Best.en: You know, sometimes you remind me of Ariel with all this collecting.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Best.cz: Víš, občas mi připomínáš Ariel s tím vším sbíráním.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Best.en: Horatio Felonious Ignacious Crustaceous Sebastian, at your service!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Best.cz: Horatio Felonious Ignacious Crustaceous Sebastian, k vašim službám!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: To tell you the truth, I have been reduced to an artist without a muse.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Abych ti pravdu řekl, stal jsem se umělcem bez múzy.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: So many Villagers have beautiful voices, but I can't pick who to give the second solo to in my next masterpiece.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Tolikrát mají vesničané krásné hlasy, ale nemohu si vybrat, komu dát druhé sólo v mém dalším mistrovském díle.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: You know them the best. Who could handle the pressure?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Ty je znáš nejlépe. Kdo by zvládl ten tlak?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Kristoff?
Belle?
Daisy?
You know, I have heard him singing to himself from time to time. And it did sound nice.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Víš, občas jsem ho slyšel zpívat si pro sebe. A znělo to hezky.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: I never knew you could do a duet by yourself...
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Nikdy jsem nevěděl, že můžeš udělat duet sám...

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Yes, I'll think about it.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Ano, promyslím to.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Oh, she reminds me of Ariel's sister Aquata.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Oh, připomíná mi Arielinu sestru Aquatu.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: So responsible. So punctual.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Tak zodpovědná. Tak dochvilná.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Unlike Ariel, who never made a rehearsal on time once!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Na rozdíl od Ariel, která nikdy nedorazila na zkoušku včas!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: I'll definitely consider Belle.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Určitě zvážím Belle.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Well, she certainly has the confidence of a great opera diva.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: No, určitě má sebevědomí velké operní divy.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: But does she have the voice to match? Hmm...
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Ale má na to i ten hlas? Hmm...

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: A band? I conduct an orchestra! *gasp* I've been waiting for this moment.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Kapela? Já diriguji orchestr! *vyděšený výdech* Čekal jsem na tento okamžik.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: We'll do it! After all, it's important to set the right tone for a celebration!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Uděláme to! Koneckonců, je důležité nastavit správný tón pro oslavu!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: What celebration?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Jakou oslavu?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Are you asking to play at my birthday party?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Ptáš se, jestli máme hrát na mé narozeninové oslavě?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Actually, you got a noise complaint.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Ve skutečnosti, dostal jsi stížnost na hluk.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Oh, this isn't about a concert to celebrate your return to the Keepsake Sea, is it?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Oh, tohle není o koncertu na oslavu tvého návratu do Moře vzpomínek, že?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: My mistake... How humiliating.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Moje chyba... Jak ponižující.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Wh—? I... Yes! Yes, it would be our honor!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Co—? Já... Ano! Ano, bylo by to naší ctí!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Though, I hope you were planning an underwater party. My musicians aren't amphibians, you know.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Doufám, že plánuješ podvodní párty. Moji hudebníci nejsou obojživelníci, víš.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Noise? Tell me what no-talent fool has called my music "noise"!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Hluk? Řekni mi, jaký beztalentovaný hlupák nazval mou hudbu "hlukem"!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Oh... You're joking! Pulling this crab's legs, eh? That's very funny, {PlayerName}.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Oh... Ty si děláš legraci! Taháš toho kraba za nohy, co? To je velmi vtipné, {PlayerName}.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Oh, it's all hustle and bustle and currents of intrigue — why, that place could send a crab like me scuttling for a bit of peace and quiet.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Ach, je to tu samý shon a proudy intrik — proč, to místo by poslalo kraba jako jsem já prchat za kouskem klidu a ticha.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: And all those princesses!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: A všechny ty princezny!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: It's like they were tailor-made to give me a heart attack.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Jako by byly ušity na míru, aby mi způsobily infarkt.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Teenagers. They think they know everything.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Náctiletí. Myslí si, že vědí všechno.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Do you miss them, here in the Valley?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Chybí ti tady v Údolí?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Is the Valley more relaxing than the palace?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Je Údolí klidnější než palác?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Teenagers aren't so bad.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Náctiletí nejsou tak špatní.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Not a bit! No, no, I am on vacation! I don't miss their dance parties, and their late-night harmonizing, and their... their...
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Ani trochu! Ne, ne, jsem na dovolené! Nechybí mi jejich taneční večírky, ani jejich noční harmonizování, a jejich... jejich...

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: *sigh* Maybe I do miss them a little.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: *sigh* Možná mi přece jen trochu chybí.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: When they aren't driving me up the sea-wall, they're the sweetest, most talented, kindest girls you could meet.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Když mě neženou k šílenství, jsou to nejmilejší, nejtalentovanější a nejhodnější dívky, které můžeš potkat.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Yes and no.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Ano i ne.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: I don't have King Triton bellowing for me every minute...
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Nemám krále Tritona, který by na mě každou chvíli hulákal...

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: But, I still want to keep an eye on Ariel, in case she needs my guidance.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Ale stále chci mít na Ariel oko, kdyby potřebovala mou radu.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Bad, no! Of course not! It's their job to find their way in the world.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Špatně, ne! Samozřejmě že ne! Jejich úkolem je najít si cestu ve světě.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Figure out who they really are.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Zjistit, kdo skutečně jsou.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: ... It's just the job of whoever's looking after them to worry about the scamps.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: ... Je to jen úkol toho, kdo se o ně stará, aby se staral o ty raubíře.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: What's the— Why, we're OCEANS apart!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Co to— Proč, jsme OCEÁNY daleko!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Humans. Gotta explain everything.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Lidé. Musím všechno vysvětlovat.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: What's your explanation?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Jaké je tvoje vysvětlení?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Seems like you have a lot in common, that's all.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Vypadá to, že máte hodně společného, to je vše.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Anyone ever tell you you're a little crabby?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Někdo ti někdy řekl, že jsi trochu krabí?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Lobsters have claws... and shells... and... live in the ocean...
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Humři mají klepeta... a krunýře... a... žijí v oceánu...

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Fine! Yes, we have some similarities, but lobsters are PITCHY. Crabs are always in tune, mark my words!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Dobrá! Ano, máme nějaké podobnosti, ale humři jsou HROZNÍ. Krabi jsou vždy v harmonii, zapamatuj si má slova!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: I suppose you could say a crab and a lobster are closer than a crab and a shark.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Myslím, že bys mohl říct, že krab a humr jsou si bližší než krab a žralok.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: But then, nobody wants to be close to a shark. HA!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Ale pak, nikdo nechce být blízko žraloka. HA!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Crabby? Oh, I've heard that. Every day since I came to work at the palace!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Krab? Ach, to jsem slyšel. Každý den, co pracuji na paláci!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Hmph. Think you're so funny? Well, you couldn't make a joke like that with a lobster. I'll tell you that.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Hmph. Myslíš, že jsi tak vtipný? No, takový vtip bys s humrem neudělal. To ti říkám.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Absolutely not! What would a crab do with such things?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Rozhodně ne! Co by s takovými věcmi dělal krab?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: What about you, {PlayerName}? You've got both worlds now: human AND merperson. Land AND sea.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: A co ty, {PlayerName}? Teď máš oba světy: člověka A mořskou bytost. Pevninu A moře.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: I'm pretty happy to have both.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Jsem docela šťastný, že mám obojí.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: I'm really loving life underwater!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Opravdu si užívám život pod vodou!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Sometimes I wish I had MORE legs.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Někdy si přeji, abych měl VÍCE nohou.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: To tell you the truth, I'm happy you have both too.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Abych ti pravdu řekl, jsem rád, že máš obojí také.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Makes me feel better knowing you're keeping an eye on things above AND below the surface.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Dělá mi to radost, že máš na starosti věci nad A pod hladinou.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Ha-ha! Just as I suspected.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Ha-ha! Přesně jak jsem tušil.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: You figured out that there's nothing better than living under the sea!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Zjistil jsi, že není nic lepšího než žít pod mořem!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Oh, you want to be a crab, do you?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Ach, chceš být krabem, že?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Well, I think you are just fine being you.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: No, myslím, že jsi v pořádku takový, jaký jsi.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: All I'm gonna say, {PlayerName}, is be careful! Even if she offers to help, the Sea Witch never does things for free.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Všechno, co chci říct, {PlayerName}, je buď opatrný! I když ti nabídne pomoc, Mořská čarodějnice nikdy nedělá věci zadarmo.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: She's helpful. I'm happy to have her around!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Je užitečná. Jsem rád, že ji mám kolem!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: I'm suspicious of her, too.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Také jsem k ní podezřívavý.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Will you help me keep an eye on her?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Pomůžeš mi ji hlídat?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Hmph, I'm warning you— Her help might not SEEM expensive, but having Ursula around will cost you eventually.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Hmph, varuji tě— Její pomoc se možná NEZDÁ drahá, ale mít Ursulu kolem tě nakonec něco bude stát.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: She's prickly, but not a threat.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Je trochu ostnatá, ale není hrozbou.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: I'm keeping an eye on her.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Dávám si na ni pozor.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: You worry too much.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Příliš se obáváš.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: You don't have to take my advice, but I wasn't King Triton's advisor for nothing.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Nemusíš brát moje rady, ale nebyl jsem radcem krále Tritona jen tak.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: As you should! I knew you had a good head on your shoulders.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Jak jinak! Věděl jsem, že máš rozum.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Wrong! I worry just the right amount.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Špatně! Obávám se akorát dost.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Well, then together, we'll make sure she stays in line.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: No, tak spolu se postaráme, aby se držela v mezích.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Absolutely.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Rozhodně.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: King Triton doesn't trust her and neither do I!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Král Triton jí nedůvěřuje a já také ne!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: You mean all those fancy frills and bits you go putting on yourselves?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Myslíš tím všechny ty okázalé ozdoby a kousky, které si na sebe navlékáte?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: I've got no opinion one way or the other. All a crab needs is his shell.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Nemám na to žádný názor. Krab potřebuje jen svou skořápku.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Maybe we can make you some tiny pants.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Možná ti můžeme udělat nějaké malé kalhoty.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Should I dress up like a crab?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Mám se obléknout jako krab?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: You can still have opinions.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Můžeš mít stále názory.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: You can make them, but you won't see me wearing any such thing.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Můžeš je udělat, ale mě v něčem takovém neuvidíš.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Imagine little pants with that many legs. How humiliating!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Představ si malé kalhoty s tolika nohama. Jak ponižující!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: That's better than me dressing as a human.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: To je lepší než kdybych se oblékal jako člověk.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: But you don't need to be doing that. With your merperson tail, you'll fit right in at King Triton's court.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Ale to nemusíš dělat. S tvým mořským ocasem se na dvoře krále Tritona skvěle zapadneš.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Oh, I have opinions.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Ach, mám názory.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: About music, and punctuality, and a million different things.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: O hudbě, dochvilnosti a milionu různých věcí.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: But not about human clothing unless it floats to the bottom of the sea and I can use it to cover a drum!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Ale ne o lidském oblečení, pokud to neplave na dno moře a já to mohu použít k zakrytí bubnu!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Oh, we're doing much better now that I'm not chasing her across the sea for her father.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Ach, teď se nám daří mnohem lépe, když ji už nehoním přes moře pro jejího otce.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Between you and me, I'm glad finding that prince of hers didn't dull her spark.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Mezi námi, jsem rád, že nalezení toho prince jí nezhasilo jiskru.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: You know, now that I think about it, sometimes you remind me of her.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Víš, teď když o tom přemýšlím, někdy mi připomínáš ji.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: I DO like to collect things.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Opravdu rád sbírám věci.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: I really like singing.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Opravdu rád zpívám.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Is it the yearning? I'm great at yearning.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Je to touha? Jsem skvělý v toužení.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: From what I've seen in this place, you've got an EYE for it, too.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Podle toho, co jsem v tomto místě viděl, máš na to také OČI.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Do you? Then we must play music together!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Opravdu? Tak to musíme hrát spolu!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Yes, THAT is what I'm seeing! That far-off look in your eye.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Ano, TO je to, co vidím! Ten vzdálený pohled v tvých očích.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Maybe you won't believe this, but before the Forgetting, we were doing much better since I wasn't chasing her across the sea for her father.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Možná mi nebudeš věřit, ale před Zapomněním jsme se měli mnohem lépe, protože jsem ji nehonil přes moře pro jejího otce.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: I'm glad you two were getting along.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Jsem rád, že jste si dva rozuměli.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Do you know where she is?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Víš, kde je?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: You were making lots of music?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Dělal jsi spoustu hudby?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: And we still will when we find her! Believe me, everyone the Forgetting took from us will come back, including Ariel.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: A my budeme i nadále, až ji najdeme! Věř mi, všichni, které nám Zapomnění vzalo, se vrátí, včetně Ariel.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: {PlayerName}, if I did, I'd be scuttling there as quick as I could.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: {PlayerName}, kdybych to věděl, běžel bych tam co nejrychleji.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: That's right. I would compose, she would sing. It was a beautiful harmony.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Přesně tak. Já bych skládal, ona by zpívala. Byla to nádherná harmonie.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: I'm trying to find the place with the best acoustics around here.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Snažím se najít místo s nejlepší akustikou tady kolem.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Do you have any suggestions?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Máš nějaké návrhy?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: The Cursed Cave?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Prokletá jeskyně?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Elsa's Ice Cavern?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Elsin ledový jeskyně?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: The Dream Castle?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Hrad snů?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Isn't that where Ursula likes to go? Hmph.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Není to místo, kam ráda chodí Ursula? Hmph.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Never mind. I'll find some place myself.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: To nevadí. Najdu si nějaké místo sám.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Hmm... I wonder what the acoustics and echoes would be like in ice...
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Hmm... Zajímalo by mě, jaká by byla akustika a ozvěny v ledu...

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: If only there was some way to get past that bitter cold...
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Kdyby jen existoval způsob, jak se dostat přes tu krutou zimu...

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Hmm... it may be too echoey.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Hmm... možná to bude příliš ozvěnové.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: But there is nothing quite like high ceilings to make music soar. I will certainly give it a try!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Ale nic se nevyrovná vysokým stropům, které umožňují hudbě vzlétnout. Určitě to vyzkouším!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: There's only one way: with a full orchestra! Or a small ensemble with me conducting, of course.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Existuje jen jeden způsob: s celým orchestrem! Nebo s malým ansámblem, kde budu dirigovat, samozřejmě.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Though, I heard somewhere that you humans have ways to listen to music that DON'T involve musicians playing together.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Slyšel jsem, že vy lidé máte způsoby, jak poslouchat hudbu, které NEZAHŇUJÍ hudebníky hrající společně.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: What is that all about?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: O co jde?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: My favorite way to listen to music is...
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Můj oblíbený způsob, jak poslouchat hudbu, je...

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: ...on vinyl. You can't beat that warmth.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: ...na vinylu. To teplo se nedá překonat.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: ...on my phone. I take it with me everywhere.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: ...na svém telefonu. Beru si ho všude s sebou.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: ...live. Live is best.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: ...naživo. Naživo je to nejlepší.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: The way sound is etched into the vinyl gives the music a unique charm.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Způsob, jakým je zvuk vyrytý do vinylu, dává hudbě jedinečné kouzlo.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: You had me at "charm" but you lost me at "etched."
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Získal jsi mě u "kouzla", ale ztratil jsi mě u "vyrytého."

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Maybe you can teach this old crab what this "vinyl" is all about.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Možná mi můžeš ukázat, co to vlastně "vinyl" je.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Music that travels WITH you? Now that's something I'd like to see.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Hudba, která cestuje S tebou? To bych rád viděl.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: I could never conduct my orchestra on the move.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Nikdy bych nedokázal řídit své orchestry na cestách.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: I knew it!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: To jsem věděl!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: Sometimes, when the percussion is really booming, it rumbles my shell.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: Někdy, když je perkusní hudba opravdu silná, otřásá to mou schránkou.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.en: It's one of the best feelings in the world.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Disc.cz: To je jeden z nejlepších pocitů na světě.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gift.en: You shouldn't have... But I'm glad you did!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gift.cz: Nemusel jsi... Ale jsem rád, že jsi to udělal!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gift.en: Aw, you certainly know how to make a crab happy!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gift.cz: Ach, ty víš, jak udělat kraba šťastným!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gift.en: That's just about the nicest thing anyone's ever done for me.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gift.cz: To je snad to nejhezčí, co pro mě kdo kdy udělal.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: I could compose the most beautiful symphony about this Valley!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Mohl bych složit tu nejkrásnější symfonii o tomto Údolí!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: Sorry, I can't talk now.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Omlouvám se, teď nemohu mluvit.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: The human world is one big mess, but you've got something very special here.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Lidský svět je jeden velký chaos, ale ty tu máš něco velmi zvláštního.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: Sorry, I can't right now.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Omlouvám se, teď nemohu.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: I'm almost ready to show you my newest composition. I'm telling you, it will be my finest achievement yet!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Jsem téměř připraven ti ukázat svou nejnovější skladbu. Říkám ti, bude to můj nejlepší výtvor!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: Sorry, I can't right now.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Omlouvám se, teď nemohu.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: Oh, I hope His Majesty hasn't hired that tune-deaf beluga as my temporary replacement.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Ach, doufám, že Jeho Veličenstvo nenajal tu tónově hluchou belugu jako mou dočasnou náhradu.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: Sorry, I can't right now.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Omlouvám se, teď nemohu.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: You know, King Triton often comes to me for advice on his most troubling problems...
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Víš, král Triton se na mě často obrací pro radu ohledně svých největších problémů...

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: Sorry, I can't right now.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Omlouvám se, teď nemohu.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: If you see Flounder, tell that guppy he's late!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Pokud uvidíš Floundera, řekni mu, že je pozdě!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: Sorry, I can't right now.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Omlouvám se, teď nemohu.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: What are you up so early for?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Na co jsi tak brzy vzhůru?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: Sorry, I can't right now.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Omlouvám se, teď nemohu.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: Be quick now. This crab likes his early bedtime.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Buď rychlý. Tento krab má rád brzké spaní.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: Sorry, I can't right now.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Omlouvám se, teď nemohu.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: I'll never understand why humans get so upset about things getting wet from the rain.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Nikdy nepochopím, proč se lidé tak rozčilují, když se něco namočí deštěm.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: Sorry, I can't right now.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Omlouvám se, teď nemohu.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: Well, it's like I always say: Everyone needs space sometimes. Right now, I do!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Jak říkám, každý občas potřebuje prostor. Teď ho potřebuji já!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: I'm about to be a grilled prawn if I don't find me some shade!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Brzy budu grilovaný krevet, pokud nenajdu nějaký stín!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.en: Sorry, I can't right now.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Gree.cz: Omlouvám se, teď nemohu.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Hang.en: And you don't know the half of it, {PlayerName}. The most fun you can have is under the sea.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Hang.cz: A ty nevíš ani polovinu, {PlayerName}. Nejvíc zábavy zažiješ pod mořem.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Hang.en: Well, as long as there is no plan to turn me into a gourmet crab meal, sure!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_Hang.cz: No, pokud mě neplánují proměnit v gurmánské krabí jídlo, tak proč ne!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.en: Can it be? Ariel, is that you?
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.cz: To snad není možné? Ariel, jsi to ty?

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.en: Yes, it's us! Oh, it's so good to see you again. We've missed you!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.cz: Ano, to jsme my! Oh, je skvělé tě zase vidět. Chyběl jsi nám!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.en: And just where have you two been all this time? We've been searching the entire sea for you!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.cz: A kde jste byli celou tu dobu? Hledali jsme vás po celém moři!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.en: That makes sense. It is a pretty big place.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.cz: To dává smysl. Je to docela velké místo.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.en: Well, I'm glad to know you're enjoying life under the sea.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.cz: Jsem rád, že si užíváš život pod mořem.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.en: I was worried you both might've run away to some land-locked kingdom without even telling us.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.cz: Bál jsem se, že jste oba utekli do nějakého pevninského království, aniž byste nám to řekli.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.en: Oh, Sebastian, I would never do that.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.cz: Oh, Sebastiane, to bych nikdy neudělala.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.en: Now that we're all back together, we have to spend lots of time doing all of our favorite things!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.cz: Teď, když jsme zase všichni spolu, musíme strávit spoustu času děláním všech našich oblíbených věcí!

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.en: That makes sense. There is lots to explore here. I've found tons of new stuff.
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.cz: To dává smysl. Je tu spousta věcí k prozkoumání. Našel jsem spoustu nových věcí.

Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.en: Yeah, we've been doin' that too. We even met some friends underwater who were riding in a big metal fish!
Expansion04Main_Sebastian/Sebastian_ORQS.cz: Jo, to jsme dělali taky. Dokonce jsme potkali pár přátel pod vodou, kteří jezdili v obrovské kovové rybě!
